note: Viable Europe-focused matching terms total about 220 a month; about 100 more sit in stale or year-specific variants. An earlier pass (electronic-music-festivals-research.md, 2026-09-10) recorded 'best electro music festivals in europe' at 4,000; that figure was not re-measured and is not used. People Also Ask (What is the biggest EDM music festival in Europe? / What are the top 10 electronic music festivals in the world? / What are the top 10 music festivals in Europe? / Where can I find EDM concerts in Europe?) is answered in the FAQ and not listed as terms, because none was measured separately.
